sample_unit: CTG images interpreted by each of 3 AI-LLMs, 5 senior doctors and 5 junior doctors, scored by 5 blinded experts

links.outcome: AI-LLM CTG interpretation quality scores compared with junior and senior doctors on same images
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o 77.86 vs SHDs 80.43 (p>0.05) and JHDs 61.57; Gemini Advanced 57.14 and Copilot 47.29 scored below JHDs.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o scored 77.86, outperforming the Gemini Advanced (57.14), Copilot (47.29), and JHDs (61.57).

screen.reason: Empirical reader/evaluation study assessing the performance of multimodal LLMs on interpreting cardiotocography (CTG) images compared with junior and senior doctors.
